name: Make pizza dough
blurb: Good pizza is mostly dough and heat. A long, cold fermentation and a very hot oven do more for the result than any topping decision.
gear: Strong or 00 flour, yeast, salt, olive oil
A peel, or an upside-down baking tray
steps: Mix a lean dough at about 60–65% hydration: flour, water, 2% salt, a small amount of yeast.
Knead until smooth, then divide into balls of 220–260 g each.
Cold ferment in the fridge for 24 to 72 hours. This is the single biggest improvement available to a home cook.
Bring the balls to room temperature for two hours before shaping.
Shape by hand, pressing from the centre outwards and leaving the rim untouched — never use a rolling pin, which crushes the gas out of the cornicione.
Bake on a steel or stone preheated for a full hour at the highest temperature your oven reaches.
tips: A domestic oven at 250 °C with a preheated steel gets remarkably close to a pizza oven. Preheat far longer than you think.
Wet dough sticks to the peel. Use semolina and work quickly.
Less topping than you think. Overloading makes the base soggy.
proof: A puffed, blistered rim and a base that holds its shape when you lift a slice.
